about: Integrator amendments (v3 final, after the reviewer's corrections) to the frozen design of 2026-10-10 (design.json SHA-256 f738860460b12d1d2386a055e0eeef05e4b09320a42d3ca459f61a7c2b89c371), for owner decisions of 2026-10-11 that change expected behaviour. The frozen file is not edited; for each amended case the executor receives the original case and this amendment, and the amendment governs where they differ. Unlisted cases run exactly as frozen.
